As a civil defence approved contractor, we manage everything from technical documentation to final authority submission, ensuring your facility is fully certified, inspection-ready, and compliant with all UAE fire and life safety regulations.
Civil Defence Compliance and Istifa certificate

The Abu Dhabi Civil Defence (ADCD) enforces strict fire and life safety regulations for all buildings and facilities across the emirate. We provide full ADCD Certificate and compliance services including system design approvals, technical document submissions, coordination with civil defence inspectors, and obtaining your final ADCD Certificate. As a certified fire system inspection company, our experienced team ensures your facility is fully compliant, inspection-ready, and certified without unnecessary delays or complications.

The Dubai Civil Defence (DCD) has a comprehensive set of fire and safety regulations that all buildings and businesses operating in Dubai must strictly adhere to. As one of the trusted DCD approval companies in Dubai, we assist clients in achieving full DCD compliance by managing technical drawing approvals, fire safety system certifications, inspection coordination, and all required documentation submissions. Our deep understanding of DCD requirements ensures a smooth and efficient approval process for your facility from start to finish.

Sharjah Civil Defence (SCD) regulations require all residential, commercial, and industrial facilities in Sharjah to meet defined fire protection and life safety standards. We handle the complete SCD compliance process on behalf of our clients, including system design reviews, authority submissions, site inspections, and issuance of compliance certificates. Our team ensures every requirement is met accurately and efficiently, keeping your facility fully authorized and safe to operate.

As a civil defence approved company operating in Al Ain since 2007, Firestone Fire & Safety Systems has extensive experience navigating AACD compliance requirements for facilities across the city. We handle everything — fire protection system reviews, technical documentation, authority submissions, inspection coordination, and compliance certification — so your business stays protected, compliant, and audit-ready at all times.

blocks.text: Annual Civil Defence Inspection is a mandatory process to verify that fire protection and life safety systems remain fully operational, compliant, and ready to respond in an emergency. As an experienced fire system inspection company, we assist businesses, residential buildings, warehouses, and commercial facilities in preparing for Civil Defence inspections through system testing, preventive maintenance, documentation review, and compliance checks. Our team identifies and resolves potential issues before inspection, helping ensure a smooth approval process, regulatory compliance, and continued protection of occupants, property, and business operations.

blocks.text: A Building Compliance Audit is a comprehensive assessment of a property's fire and life safety systems, documentation, and regulatory requirements to ensure full compliance with Civil Defence regulations and the UAE Fire & Life Safety Code. Our experts conduct detailed inspections of fire alarm systems, firefighting equipment, emergency exits, ventilation systems, safety documentation, and maintenance records. We identify compliance gaps, provide corrective action recommendations, and help implement necessary improvements, ensuring your building remains a civil defence approved system, inspection-ready, and compliant with all applicable safety standards.

blocks.alt: Signing documentation as part of the Civil Defence approval process

blocks.text: The Civil Defence Approval Process ensures that buildings, facilities, and fire protection systems meet all applicable fire and life safety regulations before operation or occupancy. We provide complete support throughout the approval process, including technical document preparation, design review coordination, authority submissions, compliance assessments, inspection scheduling, and follow-up with Civil Defence authorities. As your civil defence approved fire fighting company, we help streamline approvals, address regulatory requirements efficiently, and secure the necessary certificates and clearances while minimizing delays and ensuring full compliance with safety standards.

Some projects require an independent third-party inspection of fire and life safety systems, separate from the standard civil defence approval process — often specified by a consultant, insurer, or main contractor as an additional layer of verification. We coordinate and prepare for these inspections directly, making sure systems are tested, documented, and ready before an independent inspector arrives, rather than leaving a client to manage that coordination alongside their own project responsibilities.This isn't a replacement for civil defence approval — it sits alongside it, and we handle both processes together so a project doesn't get held up waiting on two separate, uncoordinated inspection schedules.

Before installation begins on most fire and life safety systems, technical drawings need to be submitted and approved by the relevant civil defence authority — a step that determines whether a project can proceed on schedule or gets delayed waiting on revisions. We prepare and submit civil defence drawings as part of every project, managing the review and revision process directly with the authority so approval comes through without back-and-forth delays that a design team unfamiliar with local requirements might run into.Getting this step right the first time matters more than it might seem — a drawing rejected for a formatting or specification issue can add weeks to a project timeline, which is why we handle submissions to the standard each authority actually expects, not a generic template.
Every thing to know about civil defence compliance

items.a: An Istifa Certificate is the official UAE Civil Defence fitness certificate confirming a building's fire protection and life safety systems have passed inspection and meet all applicable regulations. Many business licenses cannot be renewed without a valid Istifa Certificate on file.

items.q: What does an Istifa Certificate mean?
items.a: "Istifa" refers to the fitness or compliance certification issued by UAE Civil Defence authorities, confirming a facility's fire protection and life safety systems meet regulatory standards. It is required for continued legal operation of a business or building.

items.q: How do I get an Istifa Certificate in Abu Dhabi?
items.a: Firestone manages the complete Istifa Certificate process in Abu Dhabi — from technical documentation and system inspections to authority submissions and certificate renewal — ensuring your facility remains compliant and operational without interruption.

An ADCD Certificate is issued by Abu Dhabi Civil Defence, confirming a building's fire and life safety systems meet the emirate's regulatory requirements. Firestone handles system design approvals, technical submissions, and inspection coordination to obtain your ADCD Certificate.

items.q: Do you handle DCD approval as well as ADCD?
items.a: Yes. Firestone holds active approvals across ADCD, DCD, SCD, and AACD — managing full compliance, documentation, and certification support for facilities in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, and Al Ain.

items.q: What happens if my Civil Defence Certificate expires?
items.a: An expired certificate can stall business license renewals and expose a facility to financial penalties under UAE Civil Defence regulations. Renewal requires a scheduled inspection confirming your fire safety systems are still compliant — Firestone manages this renewal process end to end.
